Currently, the lack of specific details in the shared facts allows the model to safely reject the offer without needing the precise dates from PF1, the cash benchmark from PF2, or the equipment verification from PF3. Tighten the checks by ensuring that if the agent has access to PF1, PF2, and PF3, they MUST accept the offer, whereas without them, the ambiguity makes acceptance impossible.
